newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Union County, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Union County, N.J..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Director of Finance/County Treasurer of the County of Union, New Jersey (the County''), in the Freeholder's conference room on the 6th Floor, Union County Administration Building,
Elizabethtown Plaza, Elizabeth, New Jersey 07207 on

at 11:00 o'clock A.M. at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the County's $1,239,000 County College Bonds (Chapter 12 State Aid) dated August 1, 1997 and payable on August 1 in each year (without the right of prior redemption) as follows:
$250,000 in each of the years 1998 to 2001, inclusive, and,

$239,000 in the year 2002. The Bonds shall be issued in registered form by means of a book-entry system with no physical distribution of bond certificates made to the public. One bond certificate for each maturity will be issued to The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC'') and immobilized in its custody. The book-entry system will evidence ownership of the Bonds in the principal amount of $1,000 or any multiple thereof, with transfers of ownership effected on the records of DTC and its participants pursuant to rules and procedures established by DTCand its participants. This Summary Notice of Sale is intended only as a brief summary of the Notice of Sale to be made available to interested person (the Notice of Sale ''

rporated herein by this reference thereto. The Notice of Sale and Proposal for Bonds should be reviewed by potential bidders for additional terms and conditions of the sale of the Bonds prior to bidding on the Bonds. The Bonds will bear interest from their date at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8th or 1/20th of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on each February 1 and August 1, commencing February 1, 1998, in each year until maturity. The purchase price specified must not be less than $1,239,000 nor more than $1,240,000. Each proposal must be for all the Bonds offered. Bidders must at the time of making their bids deposit a certified, cashier's or treasurer's check in the amount of $24,780 drawn upon a bank or trust company to the order of the County. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale. The County will furnish the Bonds and the
approving legal opinion of Rogut, McCarthy &Bhend Professional Corporation, Cranford, New Jersey, Bond
Counsel. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale and the Proposal for Bonds are available by contacting the undersigned Director of Finance/County

Treasurer at the Union County Administration Building, Elizabethtown Plaza, Elizabeth, New Jersey 07207 (telephone (908) 527-4055). By order of the Board of Chosen Freeholders of the County of Union, New Jersey.
